profile.reading: This T5 Data Centers facility, T5 at Colorado Springs, sits at coordinates reverse-geocoded to 3323 Janitell Road in the Kelker area of Colorado Springs, El Paso County, Colorado, an address derived from OpenStreetMap coordinates rather than confirmed directly on any T5 facility page reached this session, since T5's own locations pages load their facility listings dynamically via client-side JavaScript and returned only generic archive section headers ("Available Data Center Campuses," "Pre-leased Sites Under Construction," "Completed Projects") to a direct fetch, both this session and an earlier one. T5 Data Centers is a data center developer and owner that has operated for nearly two decades per its own site, licensed as a general contractor in 48 states, with 22 data centers developed and more than 4 million square feet of data center space and 3-plus gigawatts of managed capacity across its national portfolio as of the operator's most recently reachable public figures; those figures describe the company as a whole rather than this specific building. Colorado Springs has drawn colocation and enterprise IT investment as a secondary Front Range market to the larger Denver metro cluster, benefiting from Colorado's lower disaster risk profile relative to coastal markets and proximity to several military and aerospace-adjacent institutions in the area, though this registry does not attribute that broader market context to specific building-level facts it cannot confirm. No facility-specific square footage, MW capacity, or year-opened figure for this Colorado Springs building was located in sourcing reachable this session. This registry treats the reverse-geocoded street address as a locational approximation rather than an operator-confirmed detail, and updates it if a future session locates a working, JavaScript-rendered version of T5's own facility page for this site.

reading.body:
T5 Data Centers has announced a 64-acre campus in Colorado Springs with 100 MW of utility feed availability, but the operator has not published IT load capacity, square footage, or opening date for this specific building. This facility is one of 17 mapped in Colorado and ranks fourth among the three facilities in the state with any published megawatt figure, meaning no IT capacity has been confirmed for it by the operator's spec page.

The campus location on Janitell Road sits in Colorado Springs, a secondary Front Range market that has attracted data center investment partly due to lower disaster risk and proximity to military and aerospace institutions, though T5 has not published whether this facility is complete, pre-leased, or under construction. T5 operates 22 data centers nationally with over 3 gigawatts of managed capacity across its portfolio, but that corporate figure does not establish what capacity is available at this Colorado Springs site.

Without published IT capacity or power allocation, the campus cannot be ranked against other AI-relevant facilities or assessed for its role in compute scaling. The announced 100 MW appears to be total utility availability for the 64-acre campus, which could include multiple buildings or future phases, but no breakdown by building, IT load, or timeline to operationalization has been stated by the operator. Readers evaluating this site for AI infrastructure significance should treat it as a location with potential future relevance pending published specifications.
